title: Feed malformed commands and responses to the TBS layer
preconditions: a per-prefix virtual TPM is running, or a gate-controlled fake data socket is substituted
steps: submit commands with an unknown tag or a header size inconsistent with the submitted octets
serve responses that close early, declare a size below the header, declare 0xffffffff, or append trailing garbage past the declared size
invariants: invariant 26: Malformed input can never produce an allow result.
invariant 23: Every untrusted parser has fixed limits for total bytes, nesting, fields, strings, collections, and processing time.
residual_risk: request-side malformation is answered by the virtual TPM's own error verbatim (transport transparency, not synthesis); response-side malformation fails closed as IOERROR or is bounded exactly at the declared size; executable evidence: wine/tests/test-tbs-attacks.py malformed family
